intro.title: Every Service, Every Detail, Every Price
intro.subtitle: We offer a high quality service because the funeral directors you choose should do everything for you. We also believe in complete transparency. Below you'll find comprehensive information about each of our services, including everything that's included and clear pricing for optional extras. No hidden fees, no surprises.
intro.credentials: With over 75 years of experience and memberships in NAFD, SAIF, and the Association of Green Funeral Directors, we maintain the highest professional standards while keeping our services accessible and affordable.

traditional.title: Bespoke Funeral Service
traditional.fullDescription: Our bespoke funeral service honours time-tested customs while allowing for personal touches that reflect your loved one's life. This comprehensive service includes professional care from the moment you contact us through to the final farewell. We handle all arrangements with dignity and respect, ensuring every detail meets your family's expectations. Our experienced team guides you through each decision, from choosing the right coffin to selecting music and readings that capture the essence of your loved one's life. The traditional service typically includes visiting your loved one at our chapel of rest, a formal procession to the service venue or crematorium, and support with the reception afterwards. Options can be added or removed.
included: Professional services of funeral director and staff

Collection of the person who has died
 in working hours.

Traditional oak or mahogany veneered coffin
with quality fittings
Use of chapel of rest for visiting your loved one.
Preparation and dressing of the person who has died. Including embalming.
Care of the deceased person until the funeral service.
Hearse for the funeral procession and four professional pallbearers.
Liaising with creative partners including Audio Visual, Music and printed stationery and florists.
Online memorial page and donations collection

contemporary.title: Modest Funeral Service
contemporary.fullDescription: Our budget-friendly service is perfect for those who prioritise cost while still desiring the exceptional level of care we provide. This service is available, Monday to Thursday in the morning until 10am or after 3pm. It can take place at the crematorium or graveside. You'll also have the opportunity to visit our loved one on a day prior to the funeral and have them dressed in their personal clothing or a modest gown.
included: Face to face meeting in our warm and friendly funeral home or at your own home.
Collection and care of your loved one any time of the day or night. (Within 20 miles). Care for up to 14 days and simple preparation for visiting. Including dressing in their own clothes.
A single visit by appointment to the deceased person for up to 1.5 hours.
A simple wood effect or Jute coffin suitable for burial or cremation.
Traditional hearse direct from our funeral home to the crematorium or cemetery.
All of the required personnel including 4 pallbearers. (Extra bearers are £60 each).
Liaising with third parties, AV Media, Music, Celebrants, etc.
Muchloved unique tribute page which is yours to keep forever.
Free online notice in the Liverpool Echo.
Ashes returned to you in the container from the crematorium.
Additional printing and stationery if required.

optional.name: Personalised route from home or another address.

direct.title: Direct Cremation
direct.fullDescription: Direct cremation is a simple, dignified option without a traditional funeral service. This choice is increasingly popular for those who prefer privacy, simplicity, or plan to hold a memorial service at a later date. Despite being our most affordable option, we maintain the same high standards of care and respect. Your loved one is cared for in our funeral home, and you can arrange a viewing if desired as an additional option. The cremation takes place at a time chosen by the crematorium, without attendees, and the ashes are returned to you afterwards. This allows complete flexibility in how and when you choose to remember your loved one, whether through a memorial service, ash scattering ceremony, or private family gathering.
included: Collection from place of death (within 20 miles)
Return of ashes in standard container

optional.name: Attended viewing, including dressing visiting for up to 1.5hours - maybe play some music, have a cup of tea

green.title: Green & Natural Funeral
green.fullDescription: Our green funeral service reflects a commitment to environmental sustainability while providing a meaningful farewell. We work with natural burial grounds across Merseyside and beyond, offering beautiful woodland or meadow settings for a final resting place. Every aspect of the service minimizes environmental impact, from biodegradable coffins made from bamboo, willow, or recycled materials, to our electric hearse option. As members of the Association of Green Funeral Directors, we plant a memorial tree for every funeral we conduct. The service can be religious or non-religious, formal or informal, but always respects both your loved one and the environment they cherished.
included: Collection in electric or hybrid vehicle
Memorial tree planted in their memory
Wildflower seed packets for guests (50 packs)
green.commitment: We offset all carbon emissions from our services and contribute to conservation projects. Every green funeral includes lifetime membership to the natural burial ground for family visits.

religious.title: Religious & Faith Services
religious.fullDescription: We understand the importance of honoring religious traditions and customs during times of loss. Our religious funeral services are conducted with deep respect for faith-specific requirements, whether Roman Catholic, Protestant, Jewish, Islamic, Hindu, Buddhist, or other beliefs. We work closely with religious leaders from all communities to ensure every ritual and tradition is properly observed. Our team is experienced in managing the specific timings, preparations, and ceremonial requirements of different faiths. From Tahara in Jewish tradition to Hindu cremation rites, from Islamic burial requirements to Buddhist chanting ceremonies, we ensure your loved one's faith is honoured throughout their final journey.
included: Liaison with religious leaders and places of worship
Faith-specific preparation of your loved one
Professional pallbearers familiar with religious customs

additional.title: Additional Services & Support
additional.subtitle: Complete your arrangements with these optional services, each designed to add meaningful touches to the farewell

direct_cremation.title: Direct Cremation
direct_cremation.description: A simple, dignified option without a traditional funeral service. Perfect for those who prefer simplicity or plan to hold a memorial service at a later date. Complete flexibility for how and when you remember your loved one.

stationery.title: Memorial Stationery
stationery.description: Custom-designed order of service booklets, memorial cards, attendance cards, and thank you notes. All items can be personalized with photos, poems, and special messages.

floral.title: Floral Tributes
floral.description: Beautiful arrangements from local florists including traditional wreaths, contemporary designs, and symbolic tributes. We can also arrange charitable donations in lieu of flowers.

memorial.title: Memorial Keepsakes
memorial.description: Fingerprint jewelry, memorial diamonds, photo albums, memory bears from clothing, and other precious keepsakes to treasure forever.

streaming.title: Audio Visual Services
streaming.description: Professional webcasting allows distant family and friends to attend the service virtually. Includes recording for later viewing and sharing.

music.title: Live Music
music.description: Professional musicians including organists, soloists, bagpipers, harpists, or contemporary performers to provide meaningful music during the service.

transport.title: Special Transport
transport.description: Alternative hearses including motorcycle, horse-drawn, vintage cars, lorries, or other vehicles that reflect your loved one's interests.

monuments.title: Attendance Cards
monuments.description: When requested we will send an usher to the venue to give out attendance cards. You may find this very useful to know who has attended the service and can contact them afterwards.

aftercare.title: Bereavement Support
aftercare.description: Ongoing support including grief counselling referrals, support group information, and practical assistance with estate matters. After the funeral we also help with sign-posting onwards to specialists and further teams.

payment.title: Flexible Payment Options

immediate.title: Immediate Payment
immediate.description: Payment in full by cash, cheque, or card. We accept all major credit and debit cards. Full payment is typically due within 14 days of the funeral.

installment.title: Payment Plans with Funeral Safe Finance
installment.description: Spread the cost over 6 or 12 months with our instalment plans. Subject to approval, with competitive interest rates and no hidden fees.

prepaid.title: Prepaid Funeral Plans with Ecclesiastical Planning Services
prepaid.description: Lock in today's prices and spare your family from financial worry. Flexible payment terms available from 12 to 120 months.

payment.note: We understand this is a difficult time financially as well as emotionally. Please speak to us about any concerns - we'll always try to find a solution that works for your family.
